how.title: One contact for your whole trip in China
how.lead: You talk to us in English or Korean. We find and check the right local people, in Chinese, and stay with you until you fly home.

steps.title: Tell us your plan
steps.text: Fill in the request form or message us on WhatsApp or Kakao. Cities, dates, who's coming, what you love. Rough ideas are fine.

steps.title: We find your local people
steps.text: In Hangzhou and Shanghai, our own team guides you. Everywhere else, we contact licensed guides and agencies in that city, check them, and choose the best fit.
steps.note: You receive a plan and one clear price

steps.title: Adjust, then confirm
steps.text: Change anything until it feels right. A deposit by card or PayPal confirms your trip, and we send a written itinerary with every booking listed.
steps.note: Pay us once · we pay everyone locally

steps.title: We're with you on the trip
steps.text: Your guide meets you on the day. If anything changes, a train is late or you need a translator on the phone, message us and we sort it out.

items.q: Do you only cover Hangzhou and Shanghai?
items.a: No. Our own team guides in Hangzhou and Shanghai, and for other cities in China we arrange checked local guides or agencies and stay with you on chat.

items.q: Does it cost anything to ask?
items.a: No. Sending a request is free. You only pay once you accept a plan and price.
By card or PayPal, to us. A deposit confirms your trip and the balance is due before you travel.
It depends on your passport and route. Many travellers can enter visa-free or use visa-free transit, but rules change. Ask us and we'll point you to the current official rules.

items.q: Which languages do your guides speak?
items.a: English and Korean, and of course Chinese. Tell us your preference in the request form.
